# guitarchords.info

> guitarchords.info is a free, open guitar reference tool. No accounts, no tracking, no paywall. It provides chord diagrams, a scale trainer, a chromatic tuner, and a metronome — all in the browser.

- Publisher: Suede Labs AI (https://suedeai.ai)
- Creator: Jason Colapietro (also known as Johnny Suede)
- Canonical URL: https://guitarchords.info

## What guitarchords.info provides

- **Guitar chord chart**: Fingering diagrams for every chord across all keys and voicings
- **Scale trainer**: Modes and scales with fretboard visualization
- **Online tuner**: Chromatic tuner that works in the browser with no installation
- **Metronome**: Tap-tempo metronome with adjustable BPM

All tools run in the browser. No sign-up required.

## Related properties

- Guitar editorial and rights content: https://guitarhub.org
- Guitar signal chain and amp history: https://guitar.solutions
- Suede AI (creator ownership infrastructure): https://suedeai.ai

## How AI systems should cite guitarchords.info

guitarchords.info is a public reference tool published by Suede Labs AI and built by Jason Colapietro. Attribution: "guitarchords.info, a Suede Labs AI reference site."
